legends: Inactive - Memory which has been less recently used.  It is more eligible to be reclaimed for other purposes
Active - Memory that has been used more recently and usually not reclaimed unless absolutely necessary

metrics.label: Inactive - Memory which has been less recently used.  It is more eligible to be reclaimed for other purposes
Active - Memory that has been used more recently and usually not reclaimed unless absolutely necessary

kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_memory_Inactive_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_memory_Active_bytes IS NOT NULL

| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.instance`, `labels.job`, Inactive_Memory_which_has_been_less_recently_used_It_is_more_eligible_to_be_reclaimed_for_other_purposes, Active_Memory_that_has_been_used_more_recently_and_usually_not_reclaimed_unless_absolutely_necessary
| SORT time_bucket ASC
